newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details primary elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details primary elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Prairie elevators tightened up to 26 percent in the week ended December 15, slightly less than 27 percent the week before, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
Alberta elevators had the most space available at 31 percent vacant, unchanged from the week before, it said.
Saskatchewan had 24 percent of elevator space available, less than 26 percent the previous week.
Manitoba had 25 percent of elevator space available, up from 22 percent the prior week.
Railcar unloads fell short of targets at all export ports.
Unloads at Vancouver totalled 2,835 railcars, below the 3,400 target while unloads at Prince Rupert reached 1,195 railcars, under the 1,500 target.
Unloads at Thunder Bay reached 2,540 railcars, beneath the 3,200 target, the CWB said.
